SMTO-CMP-0002 — Completion could not be verified

GUID: 943829f5-489c-402a-b1a6-1fc9618b7a44
Slug: final-response-unverified
Domain: CMP · Subsystem: cmp

What happened

  • The Agent says it's done, but SMTO couldn't find proof in the task's recorded steps that all the requested work happened. The answer is still there for you to read.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Read the answer and the task's activity to see which part couldn't be confirmed, such as a file that wasn't saved or a check that didn't run. SMTO only marks a task done when its recorded steps back up the answer.
  2. Reply asking the Agent to finish that part and show the result, for example: Run the tests and show me the output. New, recorded work gives SMTO the proof it needs.
  3. If the answer stopped partway, ask the Agent to continue from where it stopped. An interrupted answer can't be checked until it's complete.
  4. If the answer says the work couldn't be done, change your request instead of asking for the same thing again. Repeating an impossible request gets the same result.

What success looks like

  • The task shows as completed, and the answer refers to work you can see in its activity.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Don't send the identical request again; earlier work may already be done and could be repeated.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Final-answer evaluation could not establish acceptable completion from the current run state and tool results (for example missing proof of work, an unresolved output requirement, or an interrupted response), so the answer was kept but the task was not marked complete.

What this means

  • Retained-final-response evaluation cannot establish acceptable completion from current state/receipts, or presentation exposes an unresolved retained candidate in a nonterminal state. Completion checks consume retained evidence and the effective guard policy; they do not execute work. A rejected declaration preserves the answer and successful receipts, and only the original operation evidence establishes effects.

Why this can happen

  • Retained-final-response evaluation cannot establish acceptable completion from current state/receipts, or presentation exposes an unresolved retained candidate in a nonterminal state.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect final_response_feedback.reason and concrete open requirements instead of regenerating the answer blindly.

How to fix it

  • Inspect final_response_feedback.reason and any open requirements in the run state; complete or verify the remaining work so the tool results satisfy the completion verifiers, or accept a genuine incomplete status. Don't regenerate the answer blindly; the kept answer and successful tool results stand.
  • Resolve the remaining work or evidence requirements before completing this task.

Retry and execution caution

  • Apply the correction and confirm the relevant state before requesting another attempt. Prior completed work remains governed by its receipts.

How to verify the fix

  • Eligible retained evidence or genuinely completed remaining work satisfies the actual completion requirement.

What not to do

  • Do not repeatedly submit the same invalid input; correct the named constraint first.

Technical notes

  • Completion checks consume retained evidence and the effective guard policy; they do not execute work. A rejected declaration preserves the answer and successful receipts, and only the original operation evidence establishes effects.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
